svg.title: $560,000 Retained Fees to $196,000 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-profit-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: $560,000 Retained Fees to $196,000 Owner Net; subtitle: Four expense deductions reconcile exactly to a 35.0% net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: All values are annual USD. First and last bars are totals; the four intervening bars are negative expense movements. Cost allocations are illustrative, while revenue, profit, and margin match the canonical Base Case. The published $4,000–$18,000 monthly operating range is not an all-in annual expense ceiling: this model requires $364,000 total annual expenses, averaging $30,333.33 monthly. Do not infer that the published range funds every modeled expense.; caption: $560,000 − $156,000 − $60,000 − $84,000 − $64,000 = $196,000; $196,000 / $560,000 = 35.0%. Retained fees exclude loan principal and already reflect fee reversals for the modeled cohort.; stages: label: Retained brokerage revenue; value: $560,000 gross operator revenue; numeric value: 560000.0; detail: Opening total equals retained origination and referral fees across 40 funded placements. Borrower loan proceeds and lender-funded principal remain outside this revenue bar.; label: Pod delivery compensation; value: −$156,000 annual expense; numeric value: -156000.0; detail: Illustrative compensation and employment-cost envelope for two full-time seats and two part-time contractor seats. Validate local hiring costs and owner compensation treatment before adopting this staffing budget.; label: Recurring operating infrastructure; value: −$60,000 annual expense; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Budget $5,000 monthly for CRM, secure document handling, insurance, accounting, office services, and baseline professional support. Keep transaction-dependent costs outside this recurring infrastructure subtotal.; label: Acquisition and relationship development; value: −$84,000 annual expense; numeric value: -84000.0; detail: Allocate $2,100 per funded placement across 40 outcomes for industry outreach, events, content, and relationship development. Any compensated referral requires a separate activity, licensing, and fee-permissibility assessment.; label: Transaction and exception handling; value: −$64,000 annual expense; numeric value: -64000.0; detail: Allocate $1,600 per funded outcome across the whole pipeline for specialized file review, transaction counsel, verification, and failed-file work. Exclude costs already charged to staffing, infrastructure, or acquisition.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $196,000 | 35.0% net margin; numeric value: 196000.0; detail: Closing total matches the canonical Base Case after all four expense deductions. Treat this bar as the resulting total rather than an additional positive movement in the waterfall.

circle.title: label: Retained brokerage revenue; value: $560,000 gross operator revenue; numeric value: 560000.0; detail: Opening total equals retained origination and referral fees across 40 funded placements. Borrower loan proceeds and lender-funded principal remain outside this revenue bar.

label: Pod delivery compensation; value: −$156,000 annual expense; numeric value: -156000.0; detail: Illustrative compensation and employment-cost envelope for two full-time seats and two part-time contractor seats. Validate local hiring costs and owner compensation treatment before adopting this staffing budget.

label: Recurring operating infrastructure; value: −$60,000 annual expense; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Budget $5,000 monthly for CRM, secure document handling, insurance, accounting, office services, and baseline professional support. Keep transaction-dependent costs outside this recurring infrastructure subtotal.

label: Acquisition and relationship development; value: −$84,000 annual expense; numeric value: -84000.0; detail: Allocate $2,100 per funded placement across 40 outcomes for industry outreach, events, content, and relationship development. Any compensated referral requires a separate activity, licensing, and fee-permissibility assessment.

label: Transaction and exception handling; value: −$64,000 annual expense; numeric value: -64000.0; detail: Allocate $1,600 per funded outcome across the whole pipeline for specialized file review, transaction counsel, verification, and failed-file work. Exclude costs already charged to staffing, infrastructure, or acquisition.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $196,000 | 35.0% net margin; numeric value: 196000.0; detail: Closing total matches the canonical Base Case after all four expense deductions. Treat this bar as the resulting total rather than an additional positive movement in the waterfall.

text.title: Assumptions: All values are annual USD. First and last bars are totals; the four intervening bars are negative expense movements. Cost allocations are illustrative, while revenue, profit, and margin match the canonical Base Case. The published $4,000–$18,000 monthly operating range is not an all-in annual expense ceiling: this model requires $364,000 total annual expenses, averaging $30,333.33 monthly. Do not infer that the published range funds every modeled expense.
